messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — SLO breach: OrbisHealth (VPC: orbis-eu-west-1). p99 latency 2.8s over last 5m, error rate small but steady. Paging oncall @maria. Runbook: /runbooks/vpc-tenant-p99
maria: On it. Pulling dashboards and recent deployment activity.
maria: Orbis dedicated pool 'orpheus-euw' showing queue depth spike and GPU saturation on shard-3. p95 also up ~900ms. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/orpheus-euw (link)
jake: Noted. KV cache miss rate jumped ~6x for model=gpt-small-quant, seq_len distribution shifted >512. Batching latency also spiked. I see repeated ECONNRESET to shard-3's grpc endpoint in logs.
lee: Any tenant-specific release? Traffic looks chatty with many long streaming sessions — long prefixes, many tokens per call. Could be a migration or data backfill. Recommend temporary per-tenant rate limit + fallback to a smaller model variant.
amanda: Orbis CS confirms they kicked a migration at 11:12 UTC targeting conversation-store. They're rolling it back now. ETA ~10m.
jake: Proposed mitigation steps (short window): 1) Reroute Orbis traffic to warm-spare pool in eu-west-2 2) Apply per-tenant throttling (20rps) 3) Enable model fallback to gpt-small-std until stable. I'll action 1+2.
lee: Applying routing rule now: `redwood route update --tenant orbis --from orpheus-euw --to warm-spare-euw2 --force`
deploy-bot: Command issued by lee: `redwood route update --tenant orbis --from orpheus-euw --to warm-spare-euw2 --force` — status: queued -> success (txn=0xabc123)
maria: Throttle applied: 20rps for tenant=orbis (policy id: thrott-orbis-7429). Observability: within 90s p99 dropped to ~1.1s, CPU on shard-3 returning to normal.
amanda: Orbis confirms rollback complete at 11:23 UTC. They see degraded UX clearing. Thanks for the quick response.
jake: Keeping model fallback enabled for 15m grace period. Plan: monitor for 30m, then gradually lift throttles and remove route if stable.
maria: :thumbsup: Monitoring charts and traces. Will hand off to night oncall in 30m if stable, otherwise escalate.
lee: Leaving a note in the incident ticket: routing + throttle mitigated impact; root cause likely migration-induced traffic pattern with streaming long-prefix sessions exposing cache pressure. Follow-up: add runbook step to pre-warm KV cache for large rolling migrations.
maria: Closing the war-room thread for active mitigation. Updates will be posted to the ticket and a postmortem if needed.
